extra.message: OS command injection vulnerability in acct_shell_probe_700. User-controlled 'host' parameter from request.GET is concatenated directly into a shell command passed to os.system(). An attacker can inject arbitrary commands.

Insecure deserialization vulnerability in acct_bundle_thaw_184. User-controlled data from request.body or request.GET is passed to pickle.loads() without validation. This allows arbitrary code execution.

Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) vulnerability in acct_jinja_cast_682. User-controlled 'fragment' parameter from request.GET is directly rendered in a Jinja2 template without sanitization, allowing code execution.
